data.title: SEO: meta/OG/Twitter tags, social card image, canonical, JSON-LD (web only)

data.body: Implemented by orchestrator: og-card.png 1200x630 (mark on dotted plastic ground, zero-dep encoder, render-verified), sharpened meta description, canonical, full OG set with absolute urls + dims + alt, twitter summary_large_image, JSON-LD WebApplication (validated as JSON), single-url sitemap.xml. robots.txt deliberately NOT added — only honored at the domain root, which belongs to the main site; sitemap is submittable via Search Console. Tags are inert in the Tauri webview, so no desktop conditional needed.

Review (cold, vs plan): PASS. Verified: all OG/Twitter/canonical URLs absolute and exactly https://www.forrestalmasi.com/pattern-maker/ (https, www, trailing slash) or .../og-card.png; og desc == twitter desc == meta desc (3 identical); og:image declared 1200x630 and PNG IHDR decoded 1200x630 RGB8; card visually inspected — PM-1 mark (charcoal rounded badge, 3x3 paper cells, orange center) centered on dotted plastic ground; JSON-LD parses, fields sane, downloadUrl matches repo URL in src/main.ts and resolves 200, license URL resolves 200 and matches GPL-3.0 LICENSE file; sitemap.xml valid XML, single canonical loc; tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build clean, dist contains og-card.png + sitemap.xml, dist head keeps all tags verbatim (only expected favicon ./ rewrite + asset injection; og:image remains absolute); no src/ changes so no app behavior change. Minor note, no fix: meta description is 175 chars (~160 ideal) — SERP will likely truncate the trailing tagline 'pixels in, patterns out.'; all keywords land in the first 150 chars, plan-specified text, acceptable. Live-site 200s deferred to post-push per plan. Verdict: meets acceptance criteria -> done.
